entry_sequence.action: once I have a daily bias or Direction I will use this checklist to make sure all requirements are met before I take an entry
the first thing I focus on is a stop raid this just means that a low was put in before it was rated or broken
the next thing I look for is a market structure shift or displacement this means that a previous high was broken and aggressively moved over
I generally like to see price move back into a discount of this price range here
taking that one step further by using an OTE I can see that this is our premium up here where I do not want to be longing and this Narrows down my discount range to my OTE right in here
some sort of PD array where generally I prefer to have a fair value gut or an order block but I will also use an OTE in this area as well as a breaker block
for my entry I would personally be looking to enter the trade right here

confluences.description: each one of these Concepts could be used as an entry model by themselves however I like to blend one two or three of these Concepts together
I prefer to have a stop rate prior to the displacement so I am not counting this as a displacement move up
does that meet all my criteria it does not because it is in a premium of the range
as I move my entry closer to my stop loss my risk to reward increases however the further I go there is also the possibility that I do not get filled on this trade
we did go a tick below this low but I do not count that personally
